title: WNS: missing error responses section (errors in headers, not body)
description: WNS has no error responses section. Unlike FCM/HPK/APNs which put error detail in the response body, WNS communicates delivery status and error detail in response headers: X-WNS-NotificationStatus and X-WNS-Error-Description. Implementers expecting body-based errors (by analogy with other platforms) will miss WNS-specific error information. The section should document the WNS response header pattern so implementers can correctly classify delivery outcomes.
